summary:
Astronaut Health AI is an offline-first health companion for astronauts, built as a hackathon prototype. It tracks six vitals: heart rate, blood pressure, glucose, temperature, sleep and mood. Each reading is compared with the astronaut's own baseline, and the app explains every change it detects. Alerts come only from fixed, reviewable rules, never from AI. The app works fully offline: reports queue during loss of signal and sync when the link returns.

An AI voice companion, powered by Claude or Gemini through a secure server, understands natural English and Egyptian Arabic, follows the conversation, and supports hands-free voice. Red-flag symptoms trigger an immediate fixed safety response, and the app never diagnoses or prescribes.

NASA Research Mode adds 1,336 real measurements from the SpaceX Inspiration4 crew (OSDR datasets OSD-575 and OSD-569). Every value is kept as published, with its source, and verified against NASA's original files. Metrics NASA doesn't publish are shown as "not available", never invented.

The app is bilingual (Arabic RTL and English), with light and dark themes. It is tested with 121 automated tests and is live on Vercel.
